app.ts.description: Composes the store, service and command router into a single application.

api/router.ts.description: Exposes three transport-independent task commands. No HTTP server is running.

services/taskService.ts.description: Coordinates title validation, task storage and domain transitions.

data/taskStore.ts.description: Provides an in-memory store through a small get, save and list interface.

domain/task.ts.description: Defines the task contract and the immutable completion transition.

lib/validation.ts.description: Checks and normalizes an unknown title using the configured length limit.

config.ts.description: Declares the application name and the shared title-length limit.
